definition: Technical arrangements that preserve or restore data, applications or computing services following disruption. Includes recoverable backups, replication, failover, recovery environments, secondary sites and defined technical recovery objectives or procedures. Excludes routine storage, physical reconstruction and organisational continuity planning without a technical recovery mechanism. Backup electricity is backup_power; independent communications paths are network_redundancy. A link to a recovery site alone does not establish recovery capability or network redundancy.
